nodes.title: Me!
nodes.text: The black hole with a cameo of one of the characters I have! The Furry nebula is also another one of my characters, although way less noticable. Everything that orbits me is how I use the internet and how it forms the galaxy around me. In my eyes, a galaxy is a garden on a stellar scale!

nodes.title: Furries
nodes.text: The furry community is one of the biggest parts of my life, I would not be where I am today if not for them.
nodes.caption: This one is a picture of me taken by one of my friends while we were camping!

nodes.title: SoAp at Virginia Tech
nodes.text: SoAp stands for Society of Anthropomorphics. It is the furry club here at Virginia Tech. I interact with them on a daily basis.
nodes.caption: Another picture from camping, this one is me with some of the SoAp members.

nodes.title: The Wider Online Furry Community
nodes.text: A lot of my friends that I have made in digital spaces come from these online communities.

nodes.title: Digital Connections To  Physical Spaces
nodes.text: Going to conventions have lead me to make connections that I still keep up to on this day.

nodes.title: Social Media Platforms
nodes.text: Where I browse when I am not focused on anything in particular.

nodes.title: Instagram
nodes.text: My most used platform, I usually use it later at night to give me some cheap laughs and enjoyment. Usually I see animal videos from conservation pages, my favorite are the birds, and I like most of them. There is a lot of slop on there though, and I find myself engaged by it far more often than I'd like.

nodes.title: Reddit
nodes.text: I usually use this platform in conjunction with Instagram, sometimes swiping between the two apps. I usually use reddit to see news on communities I like, such as sporting news or video game updates. I don't really actively engage with Reddit as a participant.

nodes.title: YouTube
nodes.text: I use YouTube a lot to watch longer form content, sometimes as a break from things so I may relax, sometimes as background noise. I usually stay away from YouTube shorts and I don't use YouTube as often as Instagram.

nodes.title: Discord
nodes.text: Here are where most of the people that I actively interact with on a daily basis are. I use Discord often to interact with a lot of the friends I have made, both in person and online.

nodes.title: Astronomy
nodes.text: One of my biggest hobbies. I adore the cosmos and my life is shaped by them a lot.
nodes.caption: One of my astrophotos, M5 Globular Cluster.

nodes.title: Blogs and posts
nodes.text: I am a passive observer of astronomy posts online, but I always find myself watching videos, looking at pictures, or reading random Wikipedia articles relating to astronomy.

nodes.title: Astronomy Club of Virginia Tech
nodes.text: I do not actively engage with the astronomy club, but the people in the club are always posting their images and it makes me so envious of their setups and ability to get such stunning photos.

nodes.title: Sports
nodes.text: The worst days of my life but the best of times.

nodes.title: The Edmonton Oilers
nodes.text: Born in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, I have always lived in a family that watched hockey, especially my dad. We always watched Edmonton Oilers games and I still follow them along and watch them for most of the games they play.

nodes.title: Other Teams I Follow and Why
nodes.text: I more passively follow a lot of teams, mostly in hockey. I know a lot about other hockey teams through my times browsing sporting commnunities and talking with friends. I also follow Virginia Tech football more due to friends that I have made here at this university.

nodes.title: Gaming
nodes.text: Geometry Dash, Stellaris, and other games that I play. I mostly use Steam as my platform to play games.

nodes.title: Geometry Dash
nodes.text: This game I have played since I was a child, I have gotten decent at it and I still play it often to this day.
nodes.caption: Screenshot of my anguish and suffering.

nodes.title: Stellaris
nodes.text: I adore this game. It is a space themed grand strategy game where you explore systems, expand your spacefaring empire throughout galaxy, and engage in diplomacy (or war) with out empires in the galaxy. You can see a lot of inspiration in this website from that game!

nodes.title: Gaming Communities
nodes.text: I love talking to other people about acheivements or fun things that happen in games that we share in common.
nodes.caption: A humorous Stellaris photo I shared with a friend of mine, my five ships were beating this entire enemy fleet by simple run and gun tactics.

links.why: This is how I first talked to most of the people I know at the club here in Virginia Tech! It is also how I talk to most of the people in the club on most days that we do not have an event or a meeting.
A lot of people whom I have met at conventions I keep up with usually on Instagram, whether it is me directly chatting with them or me viewing their content that they post.

So many of my friends I have made I have made because of common interests throughout the games that we have played. Although not listed on here because I have not played in a long while, a big game for my digital connections was the Ori series!
links.caption: Game cover for Ori and the Will of the Wisps

links.why: I get a lot of my hockey news and fan blurb from Reddit.
This is the main way I interact with people from these separate gaming communities.
I usually love watching long form astronomy content on YouTube, especially those that lay out the future of our universe.
Friends on Discord are a big reason why I follow some of these teams.
